metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the penny ballad, the speech between Aylesbury and Waddesdon, and the constable at Grendon.

yesterday: The ballad was one penny. She will have it at one hearing.
You said you would tell her the horse was dear. You wanted to arrive tired, and to have paid something.
The boy is over the wall, in the dark, and he waits. The four words on the tables are wall, dark, alone, waits.
The constable called you a deficious vagrom and told the tapster to comprehend all auspicious persons. He allowed you one bench.
Six of his words are under Words, with the line that a constable keeps the peace by not understanding it.
